seo.title: Vikoma Group — Italian business in the Belarusian market
seo.description: We help Italian manufacturers find distributors in Belarus, and Belarusian companies find reliable suppliers. Negotiations, paperwork, logistics.

hero.lead: We help Italian manufacturers find distributors in Belarus, and Belarusian companies find reliable suppliers. We take on the negotiations, the paperwork and the logistics.

whatWeDo.title: Three jobs we handle end to end

cards.title: Finding partners
cards.text: We select distributors, dealers and buyers that fit the specific product. We vet every counterparty before the first meeting.

cards.title: Running the deal
cards.text: Negotiations, contracts, supply terms. We work in two languages and two legal systems, so nothing gets lost in translation.

cards.title: Logistics and customs
cards.text: We arrange shipping, prepare the paperwork, and handle certification and customs clearance.

industries.title: The sectors we know from experience

statement.text: We don’t sell goods and we don’t take a cut of turnover. What we deliver is a working relationship between two companies — one that outlasts our involvement.

howWeWork.title: Four steps from first conversation to delivery

steps.title: Introduction
steps.text: We discuss the product and the goal. Free of charge.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.text: We assess the prospects and propose a market-entry strategy.

steps.title: Execution
steps.text: We find partners, run the negotiations and close the deal.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: We stay in touch after the first delivery.
